test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 26 May 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underline segment in the given sentence.**

The Ukranian soldiers __passed in__ for several weeks.
solution:
The correct answer is **held out.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Hold out:** refuse to accept something that does not think is good enough or large enough.
 
• **Pass in**: to give something to a person who will review
